posts.zh:
dshmobile#dshmobile-plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。移动端远程控制套件：含桥接守护与扫码登录的 bundle 插件、原生 Android 应用，以及自建中继（WSS 由你自己的 TLS 终止代理提供），并支持服务端设备吊销。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1ac679cd36d04ec9ad61.html
posts.en:
dshmobile#dshmobile-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with bridge supervisor and QR login, a native Android app, and a self-hosted relay (WSS via your own TLS-terminating proxy), with server-side device revocation.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1ac679cd36d04ec9ad61.html
